title: Activation energy and catalysts
goal: Add manganese dioxide to hydrogen peroxide. It's a catalyst, something that speeds up a reaction. Predict how much of it is left at the end.
intro: Hydrogen peroxide slowly breaks down into water and oxygen. On its own, a bottle keeps for months. Tip in some manganese dioxide and watch it fizz.

prediction.question: When the fizzing stops, how much of the catalyst is left?

safety: Wear goggles and gloves. Hydrogen peroxide stings skin and eyes. Manganese dioxide is harmful if you swallow it or breathe it in.
